# LAED design system

Generated by `scripts/export-design-system.mjs` v1.0.0 on 2026-08-07T14:16:59.229Z
from `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` at `LAED-v1.1-refactoring@04f38da` (working tree dirty).

**Do not edit this file.** Change `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` and re-run the generator.

## Design intent

LAED is a secure EU-hosted collaboration platform, shipped as a mobile-first PWA.
The visual language is **warm paper and ink** with two meaning-bearing accents:

- **Navy `#1d3a57`** — shared/project surfaces and primary actions.
- **Sovereign green `#1b4332`** — private surfaces and trust cues. Green is only
  used where a real architectural privacy property holds; it is never decorative.

Single light theme. There is no dark mode. Chrome colour, not layout, signals scope
(private vs project). Type is deliberately small and tight (11px body, 9px uppercase labels
at 1.5px tracking) over a warm #f2f0ec paper ground.

## Typography

Families: sans `"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif`, mono `"SF Mono", "SFMono-Regular", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace`.
No webfont is loaded — the stack is intentionally system-local so no CDN sees user traffic.
